message.reasoning: Strong report. Check calculations quickly: sun-sync inclination at 600 km ~97.79° correct. Launch azimuth: sinβ = cos i / cos φ = cos97.79/cos5.2 = -0.1355/0.9959 ≈ -0.136, β ≈ -7.8°, correct. Period 5801 s correct. Ground track spacing: 2πR×(period×orbits/day?) Actually spacing per orbit at equator = 2πR×T/86164 ≈ 2π×6378×5801/86164 ≈ 2698 km, correct. Decay: Δa = 2π(C_D A/m)ρa² = 2π×2.2×0.3/50×1e-13×(6.978e6)² ≈ 2π×0.0132×1e-13×4.87e13 ≈ 0.40 m, correct. Sail 4.3 m² → 5.8 m, correct. Data budget: 60,000 km² × 40,000 px/km² (5m GSD → 40,000 px/km²) ×4×12 = 1.152e14 bits = 115 Gbit, correct. All requirements met. Minor: no link budget (acknowledged), Vega C not flown (2020 context, fine). C1: all addressed with references — accomplished, 9. C2: comprehensive, STK screenshots, hand calcs, appendix files — accomplished, 9. C3: detailed conclusions with limitations — 9. C4: well structured, labelled figures, references match — 9.
